title: Indicator function bounded by one
statement: Let $B \subseteq \mathrm{BoolInput}(n)$ be a set of $n$-bit Boolean inputs, and let $\mathbf{1}_B \colon \mathrm{BoolInput}(n) \to \bbr$ denote its indicator function, taking the value $1$ on $B$ and $0$ elsewhere. Then for every $y \in \mathrm{BoolInput}(n)$ one has $\mathbf{1}_B(y) \le 1$.
hypotheses_covered: B is a set of n-bit Boolean inputs
y is an n-bit Boolean input
